g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION: logical study; missing physical/protection design

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION: logical study; missing physical/protection design

g.text: R8 CANDIDATE | THREE SIMULTANEOUS CUSTOM FPGA LINKS

g.desc: R8 CANDIDATE | THREE SIMULTANEOUS CUSTOM FPGA LINKS

g.text: Power branches, probe hardware, signal integrity, enclosure fit and simultaneous capture remain unresolved.

g.desc: Power branches, probe hardware, signal integrity, enclosure fit and simultaneous capture remain unresolved.

g.text: MC1/MC2 all 80 pins each and 51 other MC3 signals pass through; 24 GTY contacts divert; five GPIO reserved.

g.desc: MC1/MC2 all 80 pins each and 51 other MC3 signals pass through; 24 GTY contacts divert; five GPIO reserved.

g.text: MC3 has 12 GTY channels. Three links each use RX0/RX1/RX2 + TX0; TX2 cable pair is reserved in baseline.

g.desc: MC3 has 12 GTY channels. Three links each use RX0/RX1/RX2 + TX0; TX2 cable pair is reserved in baseline.

g.text: Physical stack and cable fan-out. Four data pairs per cable; each port has a separate JTAG and power path.

g.desc: Physical stack and cable fan-out. Four data pairs per cable; each port has a separate JTAG and power path.

g.text: Custom Type-D proposes 12 V on contact 19; never connect ordinary HDMI equipment. NOT FOR FAB.

g.desc: Custom Type-D proposes 12 V on contact 19; never connect ordinary HDMI equipment. NOT FOR FAB.
